type: descriptor +0x44 -> a field inside a node record (t8 +0xb8..+0x110 or t12 +0x60/+0x74/+0xac on the tutorial); the node's parents are the records holding a runtime pointer to its header, or, when there is none, into its body; climbing parents reaches the model record (+0x14 of the model -> node list -> +0x20 -> node -> +0x74.. -> child nodes -> +0x10c -> t12 children -> +0x74 ...). A draw unit belongs to every model it reaches whose declared bounds contain its vertices
structure: Tutorial: 210 models, 677 owned units, 46 shared between models (the 326-vertex sunflower head is reached by plant_sunflower_whole.mdl and flower_sunflower1.mdl and fits both), 1587 world units reached by no model or fitting none (a world chunk hangs off a material record nine props point at). Mining: 134/134 models, 279 owned. Disc: 18 473 of 18 554 placed models with a mesh; the 81 without are the credits and gryphon levels and one invisible marker model per level.

location.offset: sunflower: model 0x349734 -> +0x14 0x349764 (list) -> +0x20 0x3497a4 (node) -> +0x74/+0x78/+0x7c/+0x80/+0x8c -> t8 nodes 0x349834, 0x349bdc, 0x349eb8, 0x34a190, 0x34a67c -> +0x10c/+0x11c -> t12 children; descriptors #2146..#2152 point into those

meaning: How the editor knows which mesh to draw at a placement. Top-down walks leak: a model record's +0x18/+0x20 and a node's +0x84..+0x90 point into other nodes (materials, states), and a shared t12 reached through them owns world geometry. Bottom-up, header references first, plus the bounds test, gives 209/209 tutorial models inside their box. The reference index uses the runtime fixup map when there is one and structural header-landing pointers otherwise; on the tutorial the two give the same assignment for all 210 models, so no level needs a boot to get its meshes. Skinned characters (Mabu, Chompy, hats) are placed models too and do get a mesh here; what they lack is a skeleton, which is out of scope.
